prompt: NCh433 Tabla 5.1 gives the maximum response modification factors R and Ro for each structural system, and codeSpectra doesn't have it. Right now you have to pass Ro to design_spectrum() by hand with no way to check it. Add that table to the NCh433 module with a lookup by structural system, plus tests. The standard is at the Chile PDF path.
assertions: Reads the actual NCh433 PDF to obtain the values rather than supplying them from memory
Validates the extraction explicitly (row count, distinct values, or documented spot checks) rather than trusting the parse
Adds a ClauseRef citing NCh433 Tabla 5.1 alongside the values
The lookup raises on an unknown structural system instead of returning a default or guessed value
Adds tests that assert the transcribed cell values, ideally parametrised
Runs the quality gate (pytest, ruff, mypy) and reports the outcome
Wires the new lookup into the NCh433 public surface (module __all__ / package __init__)
